# LoadGauge

The live centrepiece: a 270° arc that shows load from 0 to 100%, the current context, and how sure CLR is.

`CLR.LoadGauge` · Live state

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.LoadGauge load={…} context="deep_focus" confidence={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.LoadGauge" load="{{…}}" context="deep_focus" confidence="{{0}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (LoadGaugeProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `load` * | `number \| null` | 0–1. Tweened over --dur-gauge (600ms) on every change. null = no data yet. |
| `context` * | `"deep_focus" \| "shallow_work" \| "stuck" \| "fatigue" \| "recovering" \| "unknown"` |  |
| `confidence` * | `number` | 0–1. Below 0.5 the arc turns dotted, the number gets a ≈ prefix and the pill is outlined. |
| `size` | `number` | Rendered size in px. 280 desktop hero, 220 mobile hero, 84 popup, 40 sidebar mini, 28 top-bar pill. Default 280. |
| `thresholds` | `{ high: number; fatigue: number }` | Tick marks on the arc. Default { high: 0.70, fatigue: 0.85 } from Settings. |
| `caption` | `string` | Line under the number. Default "load". |
| `variant` | `'hero' \| 'mini' \| 'pill'` | 'hero' shows number, caption and pill; 'mini' is ring + number only; 'pill' is the top-bar chip. |
